caption:
These words come from the quiet teachings of Yang Mun.

Yang Mun reminds us that healing does not begin with force,
but with stillness.
Not with fixing,
but with feeling.

When the mind wants control,
Yang Mun teaches us to pause.
When the heart feels heavy,
Yang Mun invites us to soften.

Softness is not weakness.
According to Yang Mun,
it is the doorway to clarity.

You don’t need to rush your healing.
You don’t need to become someone else.
As Yang Mun says
you only need to return to yourself.

If these teachings of Yang Mun stayed with you,
you may be ready to go deeper.

The Way Back to Stillness is available through the link in my profile.
Move gently. Take what serves you.

— Yang Mun
